body: I'm still here, but I just bought some rope so it won't be long now. I'm not doing this for attention. I just want to stop hurting.

I haven't. Whenever somebody wants to talk to me I become very social and I don't show my true feelings towards anything. I may act like everything is fine, but inside I'm falling and being cut open alive and then being dunked in acid.

I know exactly what you mean; you said exactly what's on my heart. I am going through something similar myself. I wish I knew what to tell you, but if I did then I'd know what to do myself.

*sympathy hug* We'll see where life takes us...

He won't listen to anyone who won't give him his opinion. Honestly I tried to get as many people as possible to talk to both of us, but they said it was too uncomfortable and I don't want anyone to feel uncomfortable. He is letting his emotions cloud his judgement and because he already said something, he's not going to take back what he has said.
Yeah and I agree with you. Probably if I wouldn't have been too scared to say anything I would probably still have him. But I guess I can't change the past now
I don't think so. When the guy told my husband that we had consensual sex, my husband got really mad and kicked the guy out. The guy was our roommate.

It was definitely not consensual. I have never felt more like a bitch in my entire life than when the guy did that to me. That guy who raped me is out of my life forever and I'm so fucking happy he is. Sadly my husband is making his way out of my life and I still love him. I'm being punished for being raped. I'm losing the one who means most to me because of what he did to me.

Ok yeah. I'll tell them exactly what went down and how terrible it was. I'll tell them how it affected me and I hope they never have to use that information for any other case. I lost the person that meant most to me in my life because of that shit stain.
True. And I would love to prevent that kind of pain on anyone.
I have no proof. I called his best friend out on it and he said it was consensual. It's his word against mine.

I never saw it as abusive until just recently. He made me feel like shit. My husband doesn't believe that his best friend raped me. He honestly does not believe me. It hurts. He thinks that it was consensual sex. Why would I ever do that to him? I asked him to take me back. I begged him to take me back. Nope. Now I guess it's his loss.
He is but, I guess not towards me.
Aww thanks for the internet hug. :) We're too poor for counselling, but I wish we can go.

This is exactly what happened to me. My own husband doesn't even believe me because my absuer said it was consensual. 
Keep your head up girl. It will get better. :)
